summary: First full test run of DealLakay. Wrote pytest suite (/app/backend/tests/backend_test.py) covering meta, auth (register/verify/login/duplicate/mismatch/no-terms), seller become/dashboard, product CRUD + IMEI privacy + filters/sort + mark-sold/restore, favorites, conversations + messages (self-message blocked), reviews (self-review blocked, duplicate blocked), reports, notifications, public seller (imei stripped), admin (stats/users/products/imei/settings/category CRUD/verifications), and non-admin/unauth authorization checks. 30/30 tests PASS. Frontend smoke-tested via Playwright: homepage loads with hero search + 20 product cards, browse page returns 15 products with sort/filter controls, petertech login stores dl_token and /dashboard renders 6 stats + tabs, admin login → /admin shows 6 admin tabs, no console errors, no error-class elements on page. All demo images render, footer visible, contrast fine.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1150 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth, products, admin, messaging) for maintainability
CORS is configured AFTER app.include_router; while it still works because middleware wraps at request time, best practice is to add middleware before including routers
products list endpoint: `verified_seller` filter overrides any provided `seller_id` because the same query key is reassigned — minor logic collision
get_product duplicates get_current_user auth path via try/except; consider a dedicated optional-auth dependency
No rate limiting / brute-force protection on /auth/login (playbook mentions 5-attempt lockout — not implemented, but not required per problem statement)
email service is intentionally in DEMO mode (no SENDGRID_API_KEY) — expected per problem statement
seed_data_creation: Ran /app/backend/seed_demo.py (idempotent) — 3 sellers + 13 products. Test-created TEST_* products remain in DB (a couple visible in Browse listing).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green with 30 pytest tests. Frontend basic navigation + auth + dashboards verified. Not exercised via UI: end-to-end add-product form submission, real-time WebSocket messages, favorites heart click UI, contact-seller-btn flow — backend equivalents are covered. If deeper UI regression is needed, focus on Sell flow (/sell → category select → publish) and Messages send/receive via WebSocket.
